intentAssessments.expected: Introduce route, required-parameter, and result-contract changes in a new API version using versioning decorators, while following the documented private endpoint parent-resource template pattern.
intentAssessments.actual: The existing 2026-01-20-preview projection is changed in place: update and delete move beneath clusters, require clusterName, and update changes its generated result type.
intentAssessments.rationale: Official evolving-API guidance uses version decorators to prevent changes from rewriting earlier contracts. The private endpoint guidance confirms the parent-resource template controls the operation scope; this substantive re-scope therefore requires a new versioned contract.
